findings.evidence: Every new theorem states a torus-conjugation equality; Carrier.lean lines 120–123 explicitly say this is not a claim that the carrier is the pinned group and that no pinning is constructed.
findings.fix: Describe the file and equations as identifying the generator weights with the named simple roots; reserve “pinning” and claims about the carrier’s character lattice until a pinned-group/root-datum identification is constructed. Make the same terminology change in the new PointsFunctor docstring at line 612.
findings.issue: The title and lines 15, 20–22, and 32 call these results a “pinning” and claim they certify that the carrier has the datum’s character lattice, although the file proves only conjugation equations and explicitly disclaims construction of a pinning or maximal torus at lines 27–28.

summary: The new documentation overstates conjugation-character identities as a root-datum pinning of the carrier.
